• Preliminary admission is based
on the final Grade 11 examination
results. Final admission is based
on the final Grade 12 results.
• The prescribed seven subjects
are the subjects to be used in

the minimum of three electives
in the applicant’s NSC, the four
compulsories and the three best
of the electives will be used.
